valais-glacier-weekend-seed.title: Valais Glacier Weekend Seed
valais-glacier-weekend-seed.slogan: Two passes and 287 km, high point 2429 m
valais-glacier-weekend-seed.story: For when one day is too small for the good stuff. Out of Andermatt and back again: 287 km, roughly 5 h 31 in the saddle. On the way it passes Gletsch historic junction and Brig  and. The climbs: Furka glacier road and Grimsel reservoirs. It tops out at 2,429 m. Furka Pass and Grimsel Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: Use Andermatt overnight option → Furka glacier road as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Nufenen Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 93 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 142 km. 753 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
